name: GAN330 Keychain Cube 3x3 (10th Anniversary Edition)
description: The GAN330 Keychain Cube 3x3 (10th Anniversary Edition) is a sleek, fully functional mini cube designed to celebrate 10 years of GAN’s world-class innovation. Featuring a vibrant, transparent design and impressively smooth turning for its size, this cube offers a premium solving experience in a compact, portable form.
